title: Spec Main Shape Gate is red against objectstack main f7a3495: three objectui tests that type a helper with `ReturnType<typeof ObjectSchema.safeParse>` no longer accept `ObjectSchema.safeParse(...)` (TS2345)
body:
Filing gate ① — a defect with a named site and a reproduction (the gate run). ⚠️ One failing check, one anchor card: comment here rather than filing another.

## What is red

`Spec Main Shape Gate` (`.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml`, the objectui#9860 ruling-C gate) compiles objectui against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main`. On PR objectui#10225 (head `fea034beb7`, run `35963298894`, job `107516299101`) it compiled against objectstack **`f7a3495a43a8`** and failed with **21** TS2345 annotations in three files, none of which that PR touches:

- `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.objectPayloadFieldsMap.test.ts` (lines 120, 124, 141, 166)
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataObjectsPage.specKeyGroup.test.tsx` (lines 170, 175, 230, 243, 251)
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.fieldsMapKeying.test.tsx` (line 230)

The diagnostic, verbatim head: 「TS2345: Argument of type '…ZodSafeParseResult<{ name: string; isSystem: boolean; datasource: string; fields: Record<string, { type: … }>…' is not assignable to parameter of type '…ZodSafeParseResult<{ name: string; isSystem: boolean; datasource: string; fields: …'」. Each file declares a helper typed `(result: ReturnType<typeof ObjectSchema.safeParse>)` and passes it `ObjectSchema.safeParse({...})` (for example `MetadataService.objectPayloadFieldsMap.test.ts:91`).

## Why it is not the PR it showed up on

The same objectui base (`62597c5`) passed this gate in the merge queue on 2026-09-23 at 02:44 UTC (run `35811540120`). Between that run and `f7a3495`, objectstack `main` moved; ⛔ objectui did not. ⇒ every objectui PR opened now will carry this red until it is answered.

## Who answers (per the gate's own docblock: 「the objectstack pull request which moved the shape is the one that answers」)

Candidate objectstack commits in the window that touch the spec's data schemas or its zod line — ⚠️ unverified, listed for the reader to bisect, ⛔ not a finding:
- `95fb417` fix(deps): bump zod to the fixed line (4.6.1+) workspace-wide (objectstack#19658) — a generic type moving under `ReturnType<typeof …safeParse>` fits the diagnostic's shape;
- `502f179` fix(spec): retire `tenancy.organizationField` from the authorable surface (objectstack#19618).

Two possible landing sites, which triage routes: objectstack (the shape change keeps `ReturnType<typeof ObjectSchema.safeParse>` assignable) or objectui (the three helpers are retyped to the parse result they actually receive). The gate is not in the required set yet (objectui#9969), so the merge queue is not blocked. But the lane's enqueue rule treats a non-required red as work to dispose of first, so this card blocks landing across the whole objectui board.

## Reader

The triage seat for routing. Then either the objectstack PR author named above, or the `domain:ui` seat (objectui#5560) if the fix lands in the three objectui test files.

## Dedupe

objectui: open and closed cards updated since 2026-09-22 scanned for `Spec Main Shape`, `spec-main-shape`, `f7a3495`, `ZodSafeParseResult` → 1 hit, objectui#9944 (closed; about the gate reporting a lower bound, ⛔ not this red). objectstack: the same scan → 0 hits. ⚠️ Radius: cards updated since 2026-09-22 only.
